text.tspan: Lambda across environments: one artifact, separate accounts, alias-based rollout
CodeDeploy canary 10% for 5 min, alarm → auto rollback
env var holds only the ARN
$LATEST is mutable; versions are immutable; triggers point at the alias. Environment variables are encrypted at rest but visible
to anyone with GetFunctionConfiguration, so no secrets there. Code signing config rejects unsigned code.
Lambda is NOT on your resume: transfer the pattern from EKS (build once, promote the same artifact, OIDC, manual prod gate).
